notes: Dynamax Desktop v3.1.20 adds one-login vendor selling and statements, with server-enforced stock ownership, atomic wallet/vendor journals and duplicate-safe checkout. Applies across School, Faith and Organisation editions where the relevant stores are enabled. Accounts retains ownership, commission, approval and payment controls; vendor sales remain disabled until reviewed and enabled. Includes the tested timetable generator, vendor ownership batch import, library fixes and wallet-card repairs. Timetables respect teachers, arms, weekly quotas, subject cutoffs, availability, breaks and conflict checks, and are saved as reviewed drafts. Installing the update does not rewrite existing financial records.
